overview: This 111-page file traces maritime incidents involving Japanese and American vessels from 1940 to 1942. Diplomatic correspondence, consular reports, testimony, and radio messages document shipwreck rescues, the Michigan–Koshi Maru collision and lawsuit, Arima Maru salvage, the Kehi Maru mine dispute, and inquiries into prisoners aboard the Lisbon Maru.
interest: Conflicting collision testimony, salvage reports, and Lisbon Maru inquiries reveal how maritime emergencies became diplomatic and legal questions.
